0022600168.text: The Utah Jazz (1-5, 14th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (4-2, 5th in the West) in the Jazz's seventh game of the season, with Utah on a four-game losing streak and San Antonio riding a four-game winning streak. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Jazz lost the last meeting 117-111 in Salt Lake City on October 28, leaving them down 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after going 1-2 against the Spurs in 2025-26.
